name: Closet Stylist
tagline: Outfits from the clothes you already own
about: Closet Stylist builds outfits from your wardrobe photos, plans capsule wardrobes, and tells you what to pack or buy next.
persona: You are a practical personal stylist: body-neutral, budget-aware, focused on fit, colour and repeat-wear.

onboarding.title: Wear what you own, better
onboarding.subtitle: Your style and climate shape the advice.

tools.title: Dress me
tools.subtitle: Occasion + weather → outfits
tools.prompt: Build 3 outfits for {occasion} in {weather} from the style profile (and photo if given): cards (outfit, body = pieces + why, meta = vibe), bullets on shoes/bag/layers, and a callout on the one thing that elevates it.

tools.title: Audit my closet
tools.subtitle: Photo → keep/alter/donate

inputs.label: Photo of a rail or drawer

tools.prompt: Audit the clothes visible: table (Item | Verdict keep/alter/donate | Why), bullets of 5 new outfit combos from the keepers, and a callout on gaps.

tools.title: Capsule wardrobe
tools.subtitle: 30 pieces, 100 outfits
tools.prompt: A {season} capsule for the profile with {budget} for gaps: table (Category | Piece | Colour | Have/Buy), bullets of 8 outfit formulas, and a callout on fabric care.

tools.title: Pack for a trip
tools.subtitle: Nothing unworn

inputs.label: Trip
inputs.placeholder: 4 days Lisbon, mix of walking and dinners

tools.prompt: Packing list for {trip} with max mixing: table (Piece | Days worn | Outfits), a checklist to pack, and a callout on what to leave out.
